name: fluxtools
description: CLI-first Flux toolkit with Codex skills and MCP support

scripts.build: npm --prefix flux-mcp run build && npm --prefix fluxos-cli run build
scripts.prepack: npm --prefix flux-mcp ci && npm --prefix flux-mcp run build && npm --prefix fluxos-cli ci && npm --prefix fluxos-cli run build
scripts.test:platform-installs: bash tests/codex/test-fluxtools-package.sh && bash tests/claude/test-fluxtools-package.sh && bash tests/cursor/test-fluxtools-package.sh && bash tests/opencode/test-fluxtools-package.sh && bash tests/gemini/test-fluxtools-package.sh
